note: He fails the two criteria that actually decide fit, and the rep spotted it live. Health is not the neglected area: he trains most mornings, eats a paleo-leaning diet with real intent, skis, cycles, and when asked about pains reported only ordinary desk stiffness — "nothing, like, serious." And he is explicitly not going good-to-great; his own word for what he wants is maintain ("just looking for a good plan to maintain"), which is the exact case the rep argued the coaching is not for: "most people who do coaching, it's not like, hey, I want to get the coaching to maintain." He is comfortably clear of the deconditioned exclusion. Occupation and income were never established — he mentioned a desk job and frequent work travel and nothing more — so successful and income sit in neither list. Graded outside on two clear, material misses. This is the only call in the batch where the ICP was applied rather than described, and it cost a $6,000 sale by choice; it is the counter-example to the pattern elsewhere in the corpus of prospects closing from outside the stated ICP.
